pages.title: Atomic Clock
pages.text: Counts the oscillations of a caesium atom. The deeper it stands in a gravity well, the slower it ticks.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Grows $(item)Time-Dilated Samples$(). It runs at √(1 − 2Φ/c²) of its full speed: fastest at the top of the world, about three quarters as fast at its bottom.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Time-Dilated Sample.
A crystal grown deep in a gravity well. By its own clock it took longer to form than the outside world saw.$(br2)Made in $(item)Time Dilation Chamber$().
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Time-Dilated Sample$(): Pulsar Timing Record
